item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"The program passes `async_metric` directly as `metric=` to `Evaluate(...)(program)` and uses the normal synchronous evaluation path."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"The repro establishes that calling the async metric without awaiting yields a coroutine (`asyncio.iscoroutine(probe)`), which is exactly the un-awaited value `Evaluate` propagates as the score."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"It wraps `Evaluate(...)` in `try/except TypeError`, prints the exception type/message, and asserts failure occurs when DSPy later reduces coroutine-valued scores."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"It uses a minimal offline `DummyLM` setup with a trivial `Predict` program and one-example devset, isolating the failure to the metric path."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
